description: A run's status and the datasheets, or visualizations on a report of another type than SlideDeck, it could not refresh. Waits up to waitSeconds for the run to end and answers as soon as it does, so call it again while the status is running. A user's later run of the report reuses the id, so this describes the latest one.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

runId.description: The run, by the `runId` that `startReportRun` returned. Runs of a report started by the same member share one id, so it always refers to that member's latest run of the report.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

waitSeconds.description: How long this call waits for the work to finish, in seconds: the message to the slides agent on `getReportMessage`, the run on `getReportRun`, the batch of variants being added on `getBurstVariantBatch`, the runs of a burst's variants on `getBurstRun`. It returns as soon as the work is done, or as things stand once the time is up, so call it again while `status` is still `queued` or `running`. `0` returns at once. Defaults to `20`; at most `30`.

name: getReportRun
title: Get report run
